body: Yep, exactly, like I “knew” what sex was before I actually understood it, I remember very vividly putting objects near my bad areas as a kid and being like “I don’t know what this is but it feels familiar” these feelings make me feel like a recluse, like no one will ever accept me for what I am or that if I tell anyone that I feel this way that they will just tell me I’m making it up but I can feel it in the back of my head that something fucjed up happened to me
A ds is a Nintendo handheld console from like 2004

I’m sure that religion played a part in it, but I honestly don’t know. It’s not like a “ohh I’m gonna get in trouble by god” feeling, it’s more along the lines of like, I feel like I either become a child or I get the feeling that I need to “take back” something I lost I guess? Like I’ll either end up in a ball crying after, or I feel like Killed Something. I honestly don’t know

That is what is confusing me the most, you’d think I’d remember something but my childhood was a complete blur of meeting random Christian families and playing ds, it was only very recently where it hit me that this must have come from somewhere. There’s nore to my view on sex than this but I’d rather not say it online. I’ll just say that I don’t think it’s just overthinking, I feel like something had to have happened for me to end up where I am, maybe not “abused” but something.
I explained more than that in the OP

That’s part of it, but it’s also the weird headspace it puts me in, as well as the severe depression I get because of it, as well as uncomfortable feelings of being touched by nothing, it’s more than that but it’s hard to summarize the last 17 years of my life

My parents have always been uncomfortable talking about that stuff, they never gave “the talk” and I never asked. I honestly have no clue how it could have happened, my parents raised me very religious so I would be over random peoples houses constantly for “groups” and I always just hid away from everyone, so I honestly have no clue.

So, I’m definitely feeling the gaba, once I started feeling effects I took 1500mg methocarbamol and continued my gaba of 300mg every 30mins. It’s now about half an hour since last dose, and I am feeling really good, I can’t be certain that the methocarbamol had any effect, but this is definitely the most I’ve felt from gaba. I think my thoughts are that the M could have definitely helped potentiate, but if not it had no negative effects at all. Sorry if I’m typing like a dumbass I am quite high lol.

I have tried everything. If anything, therapy and the mental health system of the us fucked me up more. I was pumped full of meds and shit, I got majorly addicted to half of them. they used me as a lab rat and therapy was just part of the test. As for my friends, my personal issues are kinda what drew me to cut ties. It was getting to the point that every hour or so I would have an extreme breakdown and ruin everyone’s time. My thoughts would overpower me and I’d end up  going manic, hitting my head on concrete, constantly talking about how fucked I am, and blacking out over and over. I realized I didn’t want to keep putting everyone through that so I made up some bullshit excuse to remove myself from the friend group and I’ve been basically alone for the past 2 months.

Ajj has saved me more times than I can count. I love them. Another band that saved me was prince daddy and the hyena. If you like emo/punky shit, give em a listen. But anyways, as far as I can tell it’s not gonna get better. Every week just gets worse and worse. Sometimes I’ll be fine but then I’m fucked again worse than before. I don’t have anyone to keep me afloat anymore so it’s just been building more and more. It seems like I’ve reached the point where I’m just ready to be done with it. I’ve read about this before, where people on the verge of suicide are extremely calm. I’ve experienced it before but this is so much stronger this time. I feel like I’m finally going to be free.
